Tracking the Multi-Year Path to ~$385bn of Agentic Commerce: As detailed in 
Agentic Shoppers Are Coming… Who Could Win or Lose? we think agentic 
commerce offerings are set to emerge and drive new sources of consumer utility 
and faster, more durable multi-year e-commerce growth. In all, we expect agentic 
GMV to reach ~$190bn/$385bn in our base/bull case 2030 US e-commerce forecast. 
Said another way we think ~10%/20% of 2030 US e-commerce will be agentic. 
But first, products need to be developed, adopted…and consumer behavior has to 
change. So today we publish our second recurring AlphaWise survey tracker of 
consumer behavior and agentic commerce adoption. We find four key takeaways:
1) ChatGPT and Gemini Adoption Continues to Inch Toward 50% of Americans... 
47%/33% of US respondents reported using ChatGPT/Gemini in the past month, 
slightly higher than 45%/32% in October. Adoption continues to creep higher. While 
this ramp isn't rapid (as we think consumers need new products and sources of 
utility to adopt further) this level of adoption speaks to the agentic opportunity as 
products improve. Adoption on large platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Meta AI

3) ~30-40% of Agentic Users are Making Purchases...with Retail-Specific Agent 
Adoption At or Above the General Platforms. ChatGPT and Gemini continue to see 
good early signal with 38%/30% of users making purchases on the platforms in 
January. Adjusting for the 47%/33% adoption this implies ~18%/10% of Americans 
made a purchase through the platform in the last month. This is encouraging early 
signal considering how basic the products are now and the significant pipeline 
for agentic improvements we expect ahead. 
Notably retailer-specific agentic purchase behavior rates are at or above that of 
the broader platforms...speaking to the opportunity for Sparky/Rufus/Target to 
drive potential incremental growth/share gains if they can drive agentic adoption. 
For more on our view on why retailer-specific agents may drive upside faster than 
broader-based platform agents please see Internet: 10 Debates to Shape the Sector 
and Key Picks in '26.
